name: L1 Voxel Thickness Slice Stepping
definition: A method for determining the distance between consecutive oblique slices in a volume viewport to ensure no voxel overlap and no gaps. It uses the L1 norm (Manhattan distance) of the projected voxel spacing vector along the view plane normal, rather than the L2 norm (Euclidean distance).
summary: L1 Voxel Thickness Slice Stepping calculates oblique slice spacing using Manhattan distance to prevent voxel overlap, unlike the L2 norm which causes redundant sampling.
